Title: Policies for information security
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Required by every register risk that relies on a written rule. Five topic-specific policies are approved (GV.PO = 2) but there is no top-level ISMS policy, 40% of staff have not acknowledged the pack and no annual review has run.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-001 to -005 v1.0 approved; CGI-TRK-001 (60% acknowledged). Required: CEO-approved ISMS policy; first annual review record; 100% acknowledgement.

Title: Information security roles and responsibilities
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Accountability exists per document (GV.RR = 2) and CGI-POL-005 section 4 names response roles, but no ISMS role, security programme lead or RACI across the controls exists.
Evidence held or required: Held: document control blocks; CGI-POL-005 section 4 roles; CGI-TPR-001 RACI. Required: ISMS RACI covering this SoA; written assignment of the security programme lead.

Title: Segregation of duties
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Policy approval is segregated (CGI-POL-002 approver moved to the CEO), but engineers can commit straight to production with no second person, which is the code-path duty conflict behind R-004.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-002 approval record. Required: segregation-of-duties matrix; GitHub branch protection requiring a second reviewer.

Title: Management responsibilities
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Management must require staff to apply policy. CGI-TRK-001 shows 60% acknowledgement, so roughly 20 staff are bound by rules they have not read (GAP-004).
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-TRK-001. Required: onboarding acknowledgement gate; CEO communication requiring compliance.

Title: Contact with authorities
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: CGI-POL-005 section 5.6.3 commits to the GDPR 72-hour notification, but no lead supervisory authority or contact route is recorded (GAP-019), and F-002 shows the clock can start outside CGI's control.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-005 section 5.6.3. Required: authority contact register (supervisory authority, national CSIRT, police cyber unit).

Title: Contact with special interest groups
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Mapped by CGI-GAP-001 to RS.CO and RC.CO. No membership of any security community exists; also the practical feed for A.5.7.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: record of at least one membership (for example a national CERT advisory list or an OWASP chapter).

Title: Threat intelligence
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: ID.RA = 3 describes the register method, not threat intelligence. The register's coverage rests on workshop judgement with no technical or threat input (CG-02), so this control is Not started.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: named intelligence sources, a monthly review record and evidence that findings fed CGI-RSK-001.

Title: Information security in project management
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Missed by CGI-GAP-001. Features reach production with no security requirement step (R-004), and two AI tools entered the business with no project review (VR-005).
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: security requirements gate in CGI-POL-007; project intake checklist.
Related CGI-TPR-001 finding: CGI-VEN-012 and -013 adopted outside any project or procurement review

Title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: ID.AM = 1. The CGI-TPR-001 vendor inventory is one input; no inventory of AWS data stores, repositories, drives or endpoints exists.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-TPR-001 vendor inventory (17 rows). Required: asset and SaaS inventory with owner and CGI-POL-004 label per asset.
Related CGI-TPR-001 finding: 17-vendor inventory (input only - not an asset inventory)

Title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: CGI-POL-001 is approved, including section 4.5 on AI use, but 40% of staff have not acknowledged it and Otter.ai shows it being bypassed (VR-006).
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-001 v1.0. Required: 100% acknowledgement; AI-use briefing record.
Related CGI-TPR-001 finding: CGI-VEN-012 Otter.ai used in breach of CGI-POL-001 section 4.5

Title: Return of assets
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Missed by CGI-GAP-001. The rule is written: CGI-POL-001 section 4.11 requires devices, access cards and printed material back within five business days, and CGI-POL-003 section 4.5.9 requires a completed offboarding checklist for every leaver. Neither has been evidenced, and neither reaches company data held on BYOD devices or in non-federated vendor accounts.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-001 section 4.11; CGI-POL-003 sections 4.5.2 and 4.5.9. Required: completed offboarding checklists covering asset and data return and every non-federated vendor (CGI-TPR-001 Gate C).
Related CGI-TPR-001 finding: F-003 (no SCIM on Slack; leaver removal manual)

Title: Classification of information
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: CGI-POL-004 defines four tiers (confirmed, VA-01), but the scheme has not been applied to any asset (ID.AM = 1).
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-004 v1.0. Required: classification recorded against every inventory entry; approved section 4.2 amendment.
Related CGI-TPR-001 finding: CGI-POL-004 section 4.2 named no third-party destinations (CGI-TPR-001 section 1.1)

Title: Labelling of information
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: No asset carries a classification label, so the Handling Matrix cannot be enforced (GAP-007).
Evidence held or required: Held: labelling rules in CGI-POL-004. Required: labels applied in Google Workspace, repositories and data stores.

Title: Information transfer
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: The CGI-POL-004 Handling Matrix governs transfer, but it named no permitted third-party destinations until the CGI-TPR-001 amendment, which is still awaiting approval.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-004 section 4.2. Required: CTO-approved amendment listing permitted destinations by classification.
Related CGI-TPR-001 finding: F-001; F-004; CGI-POL-004 section 4.2 named no third-party destinations

Title: Access control
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: CGI-POL-003 is an approved access control policy (PR.AA = 2). It has never been evidenced operating, and the four-hour SLA cannot be met on non-federated vendors.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-003 v1.0. Required: first quarterly review record; SSO coverage list.

Title: Identity management
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Google Workspace is the identity provider (VRA addendum step 3), but Slack, Notion, Grammarly and Miro are not federated, so identity lifecycle is incomplete.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-003 JML process. Required: SSO/SCIM on Tier 1 vendors (Slack by 15 Nov 2026); KRI-V5 at 100%.

Title: Authentication information
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: CGI-POL-002 sections 4.3 and 4.5 are strong, but MFA enrolment is 80% and ACC-001 still accepts SMS until 03 Mar 2027.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-002; CGI-TRK-001 (80% MFA); ACC-001. Required: 100% enrolment report; ACC-001 retired.

Title: Access rights
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: The CGI-POL-003 section 4.7.1 quarterly privileged review is mandated but has never run; the AWS report assumes CGI performs this review (CUEC).
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-003 section 4.7.1. Required: dated, signed quarterly review records (four by Stage 2).

Title: Information security in supplier relationships
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: CGI-TPR-001 is the supplier process, so GV.SC = 2 (designed, owned, communicated). It is not 3: no review cycle has run on cadence, and the first Tier 1 re-reviews fall due Sep 2027.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-TPR-001 v1.0; VRA-2026-001/-002/-003. Required for Implemented: seven Tier 1 review records; four quarterly shadow-IT reconciliations; KRI reports.
Related CGI-TPR-001 finding: Estate 17 vendors vs 5 known; 2 AI tools found only through expense claims, with no company contract; 4 of 17 with no assurance artifact

Title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: The 18-clause checklist and Gate B (no DPA, no onboarding) are designed. 6 of 17 vendors still have no executed DPA, which is a live GDPR Article 28 gap and a likely Stage 2 finding if still open.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-TPR-001 section 7.4 checklist; 11 executed DPAs. Required: six outstanding DPAs executed; KRI-V1 at 100%.
Related CGI-TPR-001 finding: F-001; F-002; F-004; F-005; F-009 (no audit right - accepted); KRI-V1 = 65% (6 of 17 vendors with no DPA)

Title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Questionnaire domain 7 and clauses 4-5 design the ICT supply-chain control, but fourth parties behind carve-out reports have never been reconciled.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-TPR-002 VQ-33 to VQ-36. Required: CSOC reconciliation records for AWS and Slack.

Title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Review cadence is defined (12/18/24 months) and clause 9 treats assurance decay, but zero scheduled reviews have run and no change feed is monitored.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-TPR-001 tiering model and KRIs. Required: dated review records; sub-processor change-feed subscriptions.
Related CGI-TPR-001 finding: F-006 (stale Slack SOC 2); F-012 (sub-processor feed not subscribed)

Title: Information security for use of cloud services
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Cloud acquisition is covered by CGI-TPR-001, but there is no cloud-specific process, no documented shared-responsibility boundary and no tested exit, and the four CUECs are unaccepted, so the AWS opinion does not yet cover CGI's use.
Evidence held or required: Held: VRA-2026-001. Required: signed CUEC acceptance (C1); shared-responsibility statement; exit plan for Tier 1 cloud vendors (KRI-V7).
Related CGI-TPR-001 finding: VRA-2026-001 AWS PASS WITH CONDITIONS (F-010 to F-013; all four conditions are CGI's)

Title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: CGI-POL-005 is an approved plan with SEV1-SEV4, roles and targets (RS.MA = 2), but it has never been exercised and names no out-of-band channel.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-005 v1.0. Required: tabletop record; vendor incident contacts; out-of-band channel.

Title: Assessment and decision on information security events
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: SEV bands exist, but with no telemetry and no alert-to-incident escalation, there is nothing to assess (DE.AE = 1).
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-005 SEV definitions. Required: written triage and escalation path; sample triage tickets.

Title: Response to information security incidents
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: The CGI-POL-005 section 5.5 response stages are written, but no containment runbooks exist and no response has ever been performed or rehearsed.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-005 section 5.5. Required: runbooks for the top three scenarios; exercise record.

Title: Learning from information security incidents
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: The CGI-POL-005 sections 5.7 and 7.2 reviews and tabletop are written but have never run (ID.IM = 1).
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-005 sections 5.7 and 7.2. Required: lessons-learned record from the first tabletop.

Title: Collection of evidence
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: CGI-POL-005 section 5.3.2 forbids deleting evidence, but no collection or chain-of-custody procedure or log retention standard sits beneath it.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-005 sections 5.3.2 and 5.7.3. Required: evidence-handling procedure; 12-month log retention standard.

Title: Information security during disruption
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: There is no plan for maintaining security during disruption. Concentration means one AWS regional failure also removes monitoring, ticketing and runbooks.
Evidence held or required: Held: AWS snapshots only. Required: disruption plan naming the out-of-band tools; status page (CGI-VEN-017) live.
Related CGI-TPR-001 finding: VR-002 concentration: 5 vendors share AWS with the platform

Title: ICT readiness for business continuity
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Backups exist but have never been restored, and no RTO or RPO is declared (CG-01). CGI-RSK-001 gives R-002 no backup credit until this closes.
Evidence held or required: Held: AWS native snapshots. Required: CGI-POL-006 with RTO/RPO; dated restore test report.
Related CGI-TPR-001 finding: F-013 (no RTO/RPO, no restore test, export never exercised)

Title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Obligations are scattered (GDPR processor role in assumption A-06, 72-hour duty in CGI-POL-005). No register of legal, regulatory and contractual requirements exists (GV.OC = 1).
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-RSK-001 assumptions A-01 to A-06. Required: CEO-approved obligations register.

Title: Intellectual property rights
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: No register risk covers this, and it is not in CGI-GAP-001. Included because a SaaS company ships third-party and open-source code under licence terms, and the inventory shows tools bought on personal expenses (CGI-VEN-013).
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-001 section 4.6.2 bans unlicensed software on devices (a fragment). Required: software licence register; open-source licence rule in CGI-POL-007.

Title: Protection of records
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Missed by CGI-GAP-001, although CGI-POL-004 section 7 maps it. No retention standard exists for ISMS records or logs, and one Tier 1 vendor retains everything indefinitely.
Evidence held or required: Held: retention periods by tier in CGI-POL-004 section 4.2, and two record-specific rules (CGI-POL-003 section 4.7.4; CGI-POL-005 section 5.7.5). These are fragments: no schedule covers ISMS records, logs or contracts. Required: records and retention schedule (ISMS records, logs, contracts).

Title: Privacy and protection of PII
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Missed by CGI-GAP-001, although CGI is a GDPR processor for ~200 customers. Classification and breach duties exist, but there is no GDPR Article 30 record of processing and 6 vendors have no DPA.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-004; CGI-POL-005 section 5.6.3. Required: GDPR Art. 30 record of processing; six DPAs; transfer register.

Title: Independent review of information security
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: No independent review has ever taken place (GV.OV = 1). This assessment is internal and does not count.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: independent internal audit report (ISO-12).

Title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: No compliance check against policy has ever run. Acknowledgement is 60% and KRIs have never been reported.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-TRK-001. Required: quarterly compliance check minuted at the REC-10 review.

Title: Documented operating procedures
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Policies exist, but the procedures beneath them do not (GAP-017, GAP-020), and the planned runbook location shares AWS with the platform.
Evidence held or required: Held: policy pack only. Required: runbooks, stored where they survive a platform outage.
Related CGI-TPR-001 finding: CGI-VEN-011 Notion holds runbooks: no DPA, public links enabled, AWS-hosted

Title: Screening
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Missed by CGI-GAP-001. CGI-POL-003 joiner steps exist (a weak mapping kept from Project 1), but no proportionate screening procedure is evidenced.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-003 joiner section. Required: screening procedure lawful under EU/German employment law; sample records.

Title: Terms and conditions of employment
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Missed by CGI-GAP-001. No evidence that employment or contractor terms state information security responsibilities.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: contract clause referencing the ISMS policy and CGI-POL-001.

Title: Information security awareness, education and training
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Induction only, 60% complete, with no recurring or role-based training and no phishing simulation (CG-04, PR.AT = 1).
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-003 section 4.3.6; CGI-TRK-001. Required: annual curriculum; simulation results; AI-use module.
Related CGI-TPR-001 finding: VR-006: no staff instruction on CGI-POL-001 section 4.5 AI use

Title: Disciplinary process
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Missed by CGI-GAP-001. No disciplinary procedure linked to policy breaches is on file, and unacknowledged policies are unenforceable (GAP-004).
Evidence held or required: Held: the sanction statement in each policy's Enforcement section (a fragment: there is no procedure behind it). Required: HR procedure referencing the CGI-POL pack.

Title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Missed by CGI-GAP-001. Leaver access removal is written; continuing confidentiality duties and vendor-account removal are not evidenced.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-003 section 4.5.2. Required: leaver letter restating duties; vendor-account checklist.

Title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Missed by CGI-GAP-001. No signed confidentiality agreements are on file for staff or contractors.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: signed NDAs, reviewed annually (the control's own wording requires them documented).

Title: Remote working
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Missed by CGI-GAP-001. CGI-POL-001 section 4.4 (BYOD) is an approved remote-working rule set, but there is no device register behind it.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-001 section 4.4. Required: endpoint register; remote-working compliance check.

Title: Information security event reporting
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: CGI-POL-005 section 5.2 reporting channels are approved, but no event has been reported or rehearsed.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-005 section 5.2. Required: incident register entries; tabletop record.

Title: Physical security perimeters
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: No register risk covers physical intrusion, and physical security was out of CGI-GAP-001 scope. Applicable because the head office holds staff endpoints; enterprise questionnaires ask this (CGI asks it of vendors: VQ-64 to VQ-66). Candidate risk CR-03 is proposed rather than invented.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: landlord security schedule (assumption ISO-A03).

Title: Physical entry
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: As A.7.1. Building entry is assumed to be provided by the landlord and is not evidenced.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: access badge process; visitor log.

Title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: As A.7.1. The office is in scope as a place where Confidential information is handled on screen.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: office security rules.

Title: Physical security monitoring
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: EXCLUDED. There are no secure areas or on-premises information processing facilities: production runs in AWS, whose physical monitoring is assured through A.5.23 (VRA-2026-001). The serviced office holds only portable endpoints. Re-include if servers, network equipment or Confidential paper records are kept on site.
Evidence held or required: Held: VRA-2026-001 (AWS SOC 2 covers data-centre monitoring). Required: exclusion approved in SoA v1.0.
Target date: N/A - re-evaluate at SoA review 30 Sep 2027

Title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: No register risk covers this. It is applicable only to people and endpoints in the office (landlord fire and flood controls); production resilience is covered by A.5.23 and A.8.14.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: landlord fire-safety confirmation.

Title: Working in secure areas
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: EXCLUDED. No secure areas are defined, because there is no server or network room. Re-include if one is created.
Evidence held or required: Held: n/a. Required: exclusion approved in SoA v1.0.
Target date: N/A - re-evaluate at SoA review 30 Sep 2027

Title: Clear desk and clear screen
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: No register risk covers shoulder-surfing or unattended screens; included as a baseline expected by customers and auditors. The rule already exists: CGI-POL-001 sections 4.4.2 (automatic screen lock), 4.8.2 (no unattended Confidential printouts) and 4.9.3 (lock the device when stepping away), which CGI-POL-001 section 8 maps to A.7.7. It is approved but unevidenced, and 40% of staff have not acknowledged it.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-001 sections 4.4.2, 4.8.2 and 4.9.3. Required: 100% acknowledgement; screen-lock configuration evidence; clear-desk spot-check record.

Title: Equipment siting and protection
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: No register risk covers this. Applicable to endpoints in the office and at home; included on a baseline and stakeholder basis.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: guidance within the remote-working rules.

Title: Security of assets off-premises
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Relates to ID.AM (no endpoint register, score 1). CGI-POL-001 section 4.4 covers device use off-site. Candidate risk CR-01 (lost or stolen endpoint) is recommended for the register.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-001 section 4.4. Required: endpoint register; full-disk encryption evidence.

Title: Storage media
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Missed by CGI-GAP-001. The CGI-POL-004 section 4.2 Handling Matrix governs removable media, and EXC-003 records an approved exception, so the rule is designed and exercised through the exception process.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-004 section 4.2; EXC-003. Required: media usage record.

Title: Supporting utilities
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: EXCLUDED. No information processing facility is operated, so there are no utilities to protect. Power and cooling for production are AWS's responsibility, assured through A.5.23 (VRA-2026-001).
Evidence held or required: Held: VRA-2026-001. Required: exclusion approved in SoA v1.0.
Target date: N/A - re-evaluate at SoA review 30 Sep 2027

Title: Cabling security
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: EXCLUDED. There is no on-premises network cabling carrying production data. Office connectivity is the landlord's shared service, and platform networking is covered by A.8.20 to A.8.22.
Evidence held or required: Held: n/a. Required: exclusion approved in SoA v1.0.
Target date: N/A - re-evaluate at SoA review 30 Sep 2027

Title: Equipment maintenance
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: No register risk covers this. Applicable to endpoints. The CGI-POL-001 section 4.4.3 patch rule is a software fragment, not maintenance, so it does not change the status.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: endpoint maintenance and repair rule (data wiped before third-party repair).

Title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Relates to ID.AM (asset lifecycle, score 1). GDPR Article 32 requires secure disposal of personal data on retired devices. No procedure exists.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: wipe or destruction record per retired device.

Title: User endpoint devices
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: CGI-POL-001 section 4.4 BYOD rules exist, but there is no register and no management tooling for the 50 staff devices (ID.AM = 1).
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-001 section 4.4. Required: endpoint register; encryption and screen-lock compliance report.

Title: Privileged access rights
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: CGI-POL-002 section 4.3.3 mandates phishing-resistant MFA for privileged accounts, but the CGI-POL-003 section 4.7.1 quarterly review has never run and the AWS root-account CUEC is unaccepted.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-002 section 4.3.3. Required: privileged account list; quarterly review records; root MFA evidence.

Title: Information access restriction
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Missed by CGI-GAP-001, and the most important omission: R-004 is an application authorisation flaw, which is this control. No authorisation design standard or test exists (PR.PS = 0). CGI asks vendors for tenant isolation (VQ-24) that it cannot yet evidence itself.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: authorisation and tenant-isolation design standard; test cases; REC-16 penetration test result.

Title: Access to source code
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Missed by CGI-GAP-001. CGI-POL-002 section 4.5.2 secret scanning is a recorded fragment, but repository access and write rights are uncontrolled. Kept at Not started to agree with PR.PS = 0.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-002 section 4.5.2 (fragment). Required: repository access review; branch protection configuration export.
Related CGI-TPR-001 finding: CGI-VEN-002 GitHub: Tier 1, inherent 15 Critical, no branch protection on the CGI side

Title: Secure authentication
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: MFA is mandated and 80% enrolled; ACC-001 accepts SMS until 03 Mar 2027. This is a brakes control: it acts before the break-in.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-TRK-001 (80%). Required: 100% enrolment export; phishing-resistant MFA on all admins.

Title: Capacity management
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: No register risk covers capacity exhaustion, and CGI-GAP-001 does not map it. Included because ~200 customers depend on platform availability (assumption ISO-A04); CGI already asks this of its own vendors (VQ-55). Candidate risk CR-02 is proposed rather than invented.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: capacity monitoring thresholds; quarterly capacity review.

Title: Protection against malware
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: No anti-malware standard covers the 50 BYOD endpoints (GAP-020).
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-001 section 4.2.3 forbids disabling endpoint protection (a fragment: nothing requires it to be installed or checks that it is). Required: endpoint protection standard; coverage report.

Title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: PR.PS = 0 and CG-02: no scanning, no remediation SLA, CGI-POL-008 unwritten. The endpoint patch rule (CGI-POL-001 section 4.4.3) is a fragment that does not cover the platform, so the status is Not started.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-001 section 4.4.3 (fragment). Required: CGI-POL-008; authenticated scan reports; remediation tickets within SLA.

Title: Configuration management
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: CG-03: there is no AWS configuration baseline and no drift detection (PR.IR = 0). This is the documented reason R-005 stays High.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: CIS AWS Foundations baseline; posture-monitoring reports.

Title: Information deletion
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Deletion is designed for vendor exits (clause 12, VQ-73) but not for CGI's own systems: no retention or deletion schedule has been executed (GAP-012).
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-004 section 4.2 retention limits and disposal methods (designed, never executed); CGI-TPR-001 clause 12. Required: retention and deletion schedule; deletion certificates.
Related CGI-TPR-001 finding: F-005; clause 12 (certified deletion) in CGI-TPR-001 section 7.4

Title: Data masking
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: There is no masking of customer data in logs or lower environments; Project 1's mapping to the Handling Matrix was weak and is not credited.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: masking rule for logs and test data; Datadog scrubbing configuration.
Related CGI-TPR-001 finding: CGI-VEN-007 Datadog: log scrubbing rules not verified

Title: Data leakage prevention
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: CG-05: there is no data-loss prevention; monitoring is metadata-only.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-001 section 4.5.2, a behavioural rule against entering Confidential data into unapproved AI tools (a fragment, not leakage prevention). Required: egress and DLP rules on Google Workspace and GitHub; alert samples.

Title: Information backup
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Seatbelt, not brakes: backup acts after the bang, limiting the impact of R-002 ransomware. Snapshots exist but have never been restored (CG-01), so no credit is taken.
Evidence held or required: Held: AWS snapshot configuration. Required: CGI-POL-006; dated restore test to a clean environment; six-monthly repeat.

Title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: No redundancy design is documented for the platform. The status-page placement is a design-time fragment only.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: availability architecture record (zones and regions); failover test.
Related CGI-TPR-001 finding: VR-002; CGI-VEN-017 deliberately hosted off AWS

Title: Logging
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Some logs exist ad hoc (application logs in Datadog), but organisation-wide CloudTrail is unverified and there is no central security log or retention (DE.CM = 1).
Evidence held or required: Held: Datadog APM (engineering use). Required: CloudTrail with validation; central log account; retention standard.
Related CGI-TPR-001 finding: F-008; F-010 (CloudTrail CUEC); CGI-VEN-007 not a security log source

Title: Monitoring activities
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: There is no alerting on root use, IAM change, public S3 or mass download (GAP-015).
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-001 section 4.10 monitoring notice (a fragment: it tells staff monitoring may occur, but no alert exists). Required: alert rules; alert-handling records.

Title: Clock synchronization
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Missed by CGI-GAP-001. A supporting control: logs without a common time source cannot support A.5.28 investigations. The provider time source is assumed but not verified.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: configuration evidence of a common time source.

Title: Use of privileged utility programs
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Missed by CGI-GAP-001. Administrative tooling with broad IAM rights is unrestricted and unrecorded.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: list of privileged tools and who may use them.

Title: Installation of software on operational systems
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Missed by CGI-GAP-001. Software reaches production with no controlled release process (PR.PS = 0).
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-001 section 4.6.2 (an endpoint software rule; a fragment that does not reach production). Required: release procedure in CGI-POL-007; deployment pipeline records.

Title: Networks security
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: There is no network security baseline (CG-03, PR.IR = 0).
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: security-group and VPC baseline; review record.

Title: Security of network services
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Missed by CGI-GAP-001. Security requirements for the network services consumed (VPC, DNS, TLS endpoints) are not defined.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: network service requirements; provider evidence mapped.

Title: Segregation of networks
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Segmentation is undocumented (GAP-014). The remediation stays at Q4 2027 in the risk treatment plan; the boundary documentation moves forward into ISO-02.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: segmentation diagram; production access boundary.

Title: Web filtering
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Missed by CGI-GAP-001. There is no web filtering on BYOD endpoints; a DNS-filtering option is proposed.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: filtering configuration; coverage report.

Title: Use of cryptography
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Seatbelt control: it reduces the impact of a stolen copy (VR-004). There is no encryption standard (GAP-012). Server-side encryption does NOT reduce the impact of a public-bucket misconfiguration (R-005), because the service decrypts for any request the misconfiguration allows.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-004 section 4.2 says where encryption is required and CGI-POL-001 section 4.4.1 requires disk encryption on devices (fragments: no algorithms, TLS minimum or key management are defined). Required: cryptography standard (algorithms, TLS minimum, key management); KMS configuration.

Title: Secure development life cycle
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: PR.PS = 0 and CG-02: there is no secure development lifecycle and CGI-POL-007 is unwritten.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: CGI-POL-007 approved; SDLC evidence per release.

Title: Application security requirements
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Missed by CGI-GAP-001. No application security requirements are defined for features, including authorisation rules.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: requirements template; sample completed per feature.

Title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Missed by CGI-GAP-001. No secure architecture principles are documented; concentration on one provider was found only by drawing the dependency graph.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-TPR-001 section 2.5 dependency graph. Required: architecture principles; design review records.

Title: Secure coding
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: PR.PS = 0 and CG-02: there is no mandatory peer review, no branch protection and no coding standard. This is a brakes control: it stops the authorisation flaw being written in the first place.
Evidence held or required: Held: CGI-POL-002 section 4.5.2 secret scanning (a fragment). Required: coding standard; branch-protection export; review records.

Title: Security testing in development and acceptance
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: PR.PS = 0 and CG-02: no SAST (static application security testing) and no penetration test.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: SAST results in CI; annual penetration test report.

Title: Outsourced development
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: EXCLUDED. All development is performed by CGI employees (assumption ISO-A02). Re-include before any contractor or agency writes code. Supplier assurance for development tools (GitHub) is covered by A.5.19 to A.5.22.
Evidence held or required: Held: n/a. Required: exclusion approved in SoA v1.0.
Target date: N/A - re-evaluate at SoA review 30 Sep 2027

Title: Separation of development, test and production environments
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: PR.PS = 0 and CG-02: there is no recorded separation of development, test and production.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: environment diagram; access separation evidence.

Title: Change management
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: PR.PS = 0 and CG-02: there is no change management policy or approval record.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: CGI-POL-007 change section; change records.

Title: Test information
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: Missed by CGI-GAP-001. There is no rule preventing production customer data being used in lower environments.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: test-data rule; masked data set evidence.

Title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
Justification for inclusion or exclusion: No register risk covers this. Included because the ISO-12 internal audit and the REC-16 penetration test will touch production; the rules must exist before either runs.
Evidence held or required: Held: none. Required: audit and test rules of engagement.
